landing.title: POINTER — Explore · Discover · Enjoy
landing.lede: Real places, live crowds and routes across Yangon — from the river at sunset to the Shwedagon at dusk.
landing.ch1Text: Search pagodas, markets, tea shops and parks. See what is open right now in Yangon time — and how busy it is — before you go.
landing.p1Text: Walk or take a taxi: distance, time and every turn on the map.
landing.p2Text: Junction City, Times City or a street market, with the YBS bus stop closest to each.
landing.p3Text: Ready to go? Hand the route over to Google Maps.
landing.ch3Title: Save it. Check in. Share it.
landing.ch3Text: Keep your favourite places, collect check-in stamps in your Food Passport and tell others how it was.
landing.footerNote: School project by Group 1 · ratings and crowds are demo data.
